copy:
AGENTROPOLIS — WHAT IS IT?
A governed city of agents.
Strategy. Execution. Proof.
Human authority. Every step.
This is Agentropolis.
technique: Controlled signal travel; sequential node activation; slow dolly push; hard settles on locked copy; rack focus on the mandate card; no camera shake; no decorative particles; no lens flares. NEURO performance: measured, authoritative, micro-movements only.
negatives: No text beyond locked copy; no unapproved characters; no 789 Studios crossover (default-deny); no watermark; no identity drift; no palette drift from 60/25/15 obsidian/cyan/red; no camera shake; no silent model substitution; no execution without cost preview + human approval reference.

characters.NEURO: warm honey-brown skin; dark hair in braided crown; red irises; obsidian tactical wardrobe with cyan edge trim; calm authoritative presence

locations.obsidian-grid: terminal-tower skyline at night; mission-control spine; district corridors

props.mandate-card: physical mandate card with red approval stamp; authority object
props.execution-receipt-glyph: audit ledger frame lock; settlement object

shot_plan.description: Slow dolly push into obsidian skyline boot sequence; terminal towers light up; NEURO steps forward center frame; title lock 'AGENTROPOLIS — WHAT IS IT?' slams in.
Triad glyphs HERMES / NEMOCLAW / NEMOTRON activate in sequence along mission-control spine; NEURO gestures along the spine.
Genesis RAG Growth loop ring rotates; RETRIEVE to REINVEST segments illuminate in order with cyan path.
Camera pulls back; district corridors branch (mission-control, operations, audit-and-settlement); NEURO at the intersection.
Human hand enters right with mandate card; card stamps APPROVED with red glyph; NEURO inclines head.
Hard settle; execution receipt glyph locks into audit ledger frame; title lock 'This is Agentropolis.'; fade to obsidian.
